19-VALIDATION.md's Manual-Only table.

- PILOT-01 — the `~/.zshrc` `claude()` wrapper (session-per-claude; `NO_TMUX=1`/`$TMUX` bypass).

- PILOT-05 (live seam) — the benign no-op `claude -p` actually routed through the LIVE `cco-dream`.
- D-11 — install tmux (Homebrew), wrap `claude`, and PROVE the SessionStart hook captures a real `%N` pane
  (or apply the documented fallback).

Output: `~/.zshrc` wrapper, the plist, `autopilot/__main__.py` entry point, `INSTALL.md` (the setup +
D-11 verification record). Every `~/.claude`/shell edit reversible (backup + new files).

HARD ANCHOR: still observe-only. The running daemon logs `would_*` decisions; it sends NO `/compact`,
performs NO resume. Acting is the flag Phase 20 introduces.

Prior-art plist (~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.cc_continue_once.plist) — what NOT to copy:
- `StartCalendarInterval` (fixed one-shot) + `RunAtLoad=false` — exactly the "fixed-time guess" cc-autopilot replaces.
- It DOES show the correct `Label` / `ProgramArguments` / `Standard{Out,Error}Path` shape to mirror.

The cc-autopilot LaunchAgent (RESEARCH §2.4 — verified against launchd.info):
- `Label` = `com.user.ccautopilot` (DISTINCT label; the live one-shot is `com.user.cc_continue_once`).
- `RunAtLoad` = true AND `KeepAlive` = true → "launchd starts the job unconditionally when loaded" + restarts on exit.
- `ThrottleInterval` (e.g. 10) caps restart rate (anti crash-loop).
- `Standard{Out,Error}Path` → `~/Developer/cc-autopilot/logs/daemon.{out,err}` (stderr crash capture, distinct from the JSONL action log).
- `EnvironmentVariables.PATH` MUST be explicit/absolute — a LaunchAgent's env is SPARSE (NOT the interactive $PATH);
  include the Homebrew tmux dir + `~/.claude/bin` so the daemon finds `tmux` and `cco-dream` (RESEARCH §5.4).
- It is a LaunchAgent (`~/Library/LaunchAgents/`, per-user GUI session) — correct for keystroke-adjacent work.
- Load: `launchctl bootstrap gui/$UID <plist>` (modern) — confirm running with `launchctl print gui/$UID/com.user.ccautopilot`.

The `claude()` wrapper (RESEARCH §3 PILOT-01, D-04/D-05):
- if `$NO_TMUX` set OR `$TMUX` set → `command claude "$@"` (bare — bypass; never nest).
- else → `tmux new-session -s "cc-<cwd_basename>-<rand>" "claude $*"` (or an equivalent session-per-claude form).
- ⚠️ The repo already has a `claude()` wrapper from prior milestones (the `--effort max` wrapper). The executor
  MUST find it (`grep -n 'claude()' ~/.zshrc` / `grep -n 'effort' ~/.zshrc`) and EXTEND/compose it — preserve
  the `--effort max` behavior — NOT clobber it. Back up ~/.zshrc first.

D-11 ($TMUX_PANE inheritance — VERIFY-GATED, the chief risk): the SessionStart hook (plan 02) reads
`process.env.TMUX_PANE`. Docs imply inheritance but tmux wasn't installed. PROVE it here. Fallback if empty:
the wrapper exports the pane, OR the hook runs `tmux display-message -p '#{pane_id}'`.
</interfaces>

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| launchd sparse env → daemon tool resolution | A LaunchAgent runs with a minimal `$PATH`; a missing/poisoned PATH could cause it to find the wrong `tmux`/`cco-dream`. |
| `claude()` wrapper → tmux command string | The wrapper builds a `tmux new-session "<cmd>"` string that includes `$*`/`$PWD`. |
| the live `--self-test` probe → the system | The one place a real `claude -p` is launched this phase. |
| launchctl load → the running daemon | Bringing the observe-only daemon up against the live harness. |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-19-14 | Spoofing / Tampering | launchd sparse-env tool resolution | mitigate | The plist sets an EXPLICIT absolute `PATH` (Homebrew bin + `~/.claude/bin` + `/usr/bin` + `/bin`) and absolute `ProgramArguments`/`HOME` (RESEARCH §5.4) — the daemon cannot be tricked into a different `tmux`/`cco-dream` by a missing/poisoned interactive PATH. Verified: the plist's PATH string. |
| T-19-15 | Elevation of privilege | the live `--self-test` `claude -p` | mitigate | The probe is built ONLY via `runner.self_test_argv` → the byte-stable `cco-dream` (`--dry-run`, denylist, pre-flight), NEVER `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (D-16). Verified: `grep` finds no skip flag anywhere under `~/Developer/cc-autopilot/`. |
| T-19-16 | Tampering (command injection) | the `claude()` wrapper tmux string | accept (low) | The wrapper is the operator's own interactive shell function launching their own `claude` in their own cwd — no external/untrusted input crosses it (the user types the args). The session name uses `basename "$PWD"` (cosmetic, D-07); pane addressing is by `%N` id, never the name. Documented; not a daemon-reachable surface. |
| T-19-17 | DoS (crash-loop) | the loaded LaunchAgent | mitigate | `ThrottleInterval=10` caps relaunch rate; `Standard{Out,Error}Path` captures a crash for diagnosis; the daemon loop (plan 03) swallows per-poll errors. Verified live: KeepAlive relaunch is bounded, not a hot loop. |
| T-19-18 | Repudiation | observe-only safety claim | mitigate | The live tail (step 6) proves the running daemon logs `would_compact` WITHOUT sending a keystroke — the hard no-action anchor is empirically demonstrated, not assumed. |
</threat_model>
